parts.text: The first reference photo sets the sculpting style, clay finish, lighting and camera framing. The second reference photo is the character: keep the exact same face sculpt and head proportions. Change only what this description says: Photograph of a hand-sculpted stop-motion claymation figure, matte plasticine with fingerprints, tool marks and pressed texture, soft studio lighting, highly detailed, in exactly the style of the reference photos. A grotesque disfigured old man with an oversized bobble head, mottled skin with age spots, small sunken bloodshot eyes in swollen red-rimmed lids, a large ear with a fat hanging lobe, thick neck, hunched broad shoulders, head turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right. Head type: a lopsided skull that sags and melts down one side, one cheek drooping lower than the other, bloodless pale blue clay skin, a greasy black comb-over, raised blue clay veins on the forehead, his visible ear has a small ragged rip through the top edge, a notch of missing flesh crusted with dried blood. A cracked grey papier-mache mask with a crooked moaning open mouth and two round hollow eye holes, under a ragged grey burlap hood (not white, not a long drooping face, no black drips). Wearing a filthy long trench coat, his right fist grips a big old glass syringe filled with glowing toxic-green poison, held like a dagger: his right fist wrapped tightly around the middle of the glass barrel, thumb pressed on the plunger, the whole syringe one straight piece, the long dripping needle pointing up and out, a long woodcutter's axe slung on his back, head above his shoulder. A sage-green pressed-clay backdrop. FACING: exactly like the first reference photo, his body is in three-quarter view and his head and face are turned about 45 degrees toward the RIGHT side of the image (the viewer's right), nose pointing right; never turned to the left side and never straight on. Three-quarter view from the hips up, whole head, mask and weapons inside the frame with a little space above the head, figure centred, square 1:1 composition. SCALE (the same for every figure in the series): the figure is the same size in the frame as in the first reference photo, the bobble head the same size relative to the body, and weapons true to scale with the hands, never oversized or tiny. His right hand grips the held weapon in a tight clenched fist seen from the back of the hand, knuckles toward the camera, palm hidden, the blade angled up and out; his other hand hangs open. Avoid: text, logo, letters, watermark, brand marks, sports team logo, red chevrons or triangles on the mask, full-face goalie mask covering the forehead and eyes, white screaming ghost mask, black hooded robe, pins in a grid, extra fingers, deformed hands, cropped head, photo of a real person, cartoon outline, flat 2D, face turned to the left, mirrored pose, long finger blades, clawed glove with four long knives, red and green striped sweater, brown fedora

Pink flesh-toned clay skin, a greasy chin-length black bob, raised blue clay veins on the forehead.
